title: Omega-3 incorporation effects on the structural, rheological, and sensory properties of 3D-printed chocolate
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00475F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ruoyao Li, Sushil Koirala, Sangeeta Prakash, Yun Xu, Bhesh Bhandari
This study investigates the combined effects of two forms of omega-3 fortification, oil and microencapsulated powder, at varying concentrations (5%, 10%, 15%) on the physicochemical properties of 3D-printed chocolate.
